methods.latest: Each field holds the latest non-empty year since 2015 for that indicator, with its year.
methods.dropped: Economies with no total population, no GDP, or a latest GDP older than 2020 are left out (listed in dropped).
methods.gdp: GDP (current LCU, NY.GDP.MKTP.CN) and GDP (current US$, NY.GDP.MKTP.CD) from the latest year in which both exist.
methods.kids: Children = under 18: the sum of single-year age populations 0 to 17, female and male (SP.POP.AG00.FE.IN ... SP.POP.AG17.MA.IN, based on UN World Population Prospects), for the same year as total population. Adults (18+) = total population minus children.
methods.gov: Government expense, revenue (excluding grants) and tax revenue as % of GDP (GC.XPN.TOTL.GD.ZS, GC.REV.XGRT.GD.ZS, GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS), central government, latest year; the LCU amount for that year is kept for reference. null when the World Bank has no value since 2015.
methods.names: Country and currency names from Intl.DisplayNames / Intl.NumberFormat (Node ICU 78.3, CLDR 48.0), with a few hand overrides.
